briefdescription.para: Service entity bound to the radiologycenters table (a radiology centre).

detaileddescription.para: This header declares the RadiologyCenters class, a very small C++ type that stands for one radiology centre in the radiologycenters database table. It holds almost no logic of its own. It only names the table and lets its parent class Service do the real work of building SQL statements. You create one by passing in a data wrapper made from a client request, and the parent stores that wrapper for later use.

WHY THIS FILE MATTERS IN THE SERVER: RadiologyCenters is one of the "service provider" types in the server, next to laboratories and pharmacies. When a client creates, reads, updates or deletes a radiology centre, or manages its staff, the route layer picks this class as ServiceController<RadiologyCenters> / StaffController<RadiologyCenters>. Those controllers call the inherited methods from Service and Entity, which produce the actual SQL. The class also publishes the table name so PermissionManager can check that the requesting staff member is allowed to change this service. Without this file there would be no C++ type tying the radiologycenters table to the generic CRUD machinery, so radiology-centre endpoints could not work.

CONCEPTS TO LEARN (for beginners):
static constexpr: a value fixed at compile time that belongs to the class, not to one object. https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/language/static
JSON: a text format used to carry request data; this project uses the jsoncons library to read it. https://jsoncons.github.io/jsoncons/
Template (template <typename T>): a blueprint that works with whatever data type the caller supplies. https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp
